title: Happy Birthday to King of Bhutan.
description: :folded hands: The whole team of Yelha Bhutan would like join the Nation to wish Your Majesty on the 41st Birth anniversary/  We wish you a very best of Health and bless Bhutan with endless happiness forever and ever under your dynamic ruling.  :folded hands: We love:red heart: and respect you from the bottom our heart :two hearts:  ............................................................ Thank you for everything la.  :camera with flash: Video Kupar & Kupar Courtesy : Royal Media, BBS, yellow.bt   :musical note: Music : Drugyal Ngapa_Khachab Dorji (5Mb-Studio Production) .................................................................   __ #birthday  #happiness #royal #travel #instafollow #travel  #photo #royals #bhutan #holiday #happy #buddhist #travelstyle  #royals #king  #crown  #buddhism #photography #royalfamily #king #royalty #kingofbhutan #bhutanking

asr.full_text: Music. Who will who will not Chitto Goda's Ra will lose. To share show who will. Newan will give na Baghi. Thonka deich de gold show who will chitto. Sa cha cha cha ka ro ro ro. Meow cha sankha wildle. Sa cha cha cha cha cha te drora. Fruit cha sankha wildle. Music. Who will Anna bachu daal. Cow singana take shachun. Choonwai mechu or shoogne. Music. Dance two bachu rogi.
